The `package()` function installs only built binaries and static assets (icons, desktop file, license, README) from the source tree into standard system directories.

No obfuscated code, suspicious commands (e.g., `curl|bash`, `eval`, `base64` decoding), or unauthorized file operations are present. The package depends on common system libraries and tools (e.g., `ffmpeg`, `yt-dlp`, `openssl`), which are necessary for its declared functionality. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, remote code execution, or supply-chain tampering.
